whatIs.title: What Are All-on-4 Dental Implants?
paragraphs: All-on-4 dental implants are an advanced full-mouth tooth replacement solution that uses four strategically positioned titanium implants to support a complete fixed dental bridge.
This treatment is ideal for patients who have lost most or all of their teeth and want a stable, long-lasting alternative to removable dentures.
